findings.evidence: AnalyticToricGeometry/README.md lines 151–156 order primitive-ray generation before regularity and simpliciality; `rg "generation of the cone|primitive rays|simplicial" code/TauCeti` finds no toric theorem, while Regular.lean lines 123–124 explicitly acknowledge that simpliciality is unavailable.
findings.fix: First land the primitive-ray generation theorem on main or make this PR depend on an open PR supplying it; then complete the regular-cone simpliciality step.
findings.issue: This introduces Layer 0 item 4 while the preceding item 3 still lacks generation of a toric cone by its primitive rays, which is required to derive the roadmap’s simpliciality result and the dimension-indexed Layer 2 chart.

summary: The work is coherent and directly targets regular cones, but it advances Layer 0 item 4 before a required clause of item 3 has landed.
